content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_TO_VACATE
content_blocks.text: Liam S. Thompson is hereby notified to vacate the premises located at 123 Elm Street, Maplewood, within fifteen (15) days from the date of this Notice.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_REASON_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: The reason for this Notice is due to non-payment of rent as per the Lease Agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._ACTION_REQUIRED
content_blocks.text: Failure to comply with this Notice may result in further legal action against the Tenant.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 15th day of April 2024.
